description: This file defines the SugarRest class, a core component implementing a REST protocol interface for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It handles incoming REST requests, invokes specified methods on an implementation object, and manages response and error handling.

classes.name: SugarRest
classes.description: A class implementing core REST protocol logic, handling request dispatching, response generation, and error management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarRest object with a specified implementation class name.

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Prints the JSON-encoded version of the input array.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Dispatches REST method calls based on request parameters, invoking the corresponding method on the implementation object, or outputs WSDL info or errors.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Handles error response by delegating to generateFaultResponse.

methods.name: generateFaultResponse
methods.description: Outputs an error message and sets HTTP status for a fault scenario, including logging.
